integrity: The proof is a self-contained combinatorial PL argument, supported but not replaced by finite exact verification. Existing forest counts are credited. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for even polygons and the reflection through opposite side midpoints; comparison with an entire historically relevant monograph chapter remains incomplete; does not classify other reflections or arbitrary subgroups.
title: Reflection folding of noncrossing-forest simplicial complexes
